item.title: Spanish DTT in the NAS: a Docker image for tdt-local
item.description: tdt-local ships no Docker, so I built an image for it: it downloads the release, verifies it with SHA-256 and starts it listening on the LAN. Here's what's inside, the Unraid template, and the trap around settings you can't save.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro

item.title: Expand Aurora VM disk on Unraid and resize partitions
item.description: How to expand the virtual disk of an Aurora VM running on Unraid and resize Btrfs partitions within the operating system.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro
